subject: Genetics
title: The Horvath Clock
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Horvath Clock.

hook.text: Steve Horvath found that methylation at 353 DNA sites predicts your biological age within 3.6 years.

buildup.text: The epigenetic clock measures biological age—not years lived.

discovery.text: People whose epigenetic age exceeds chronological age die sooner.

twist.text: The clock ticks in every tissue, starting before birth. Even embryonic cells show age-related methylation changes.

climax.text: If we can measure biological age precisely, we can test anti-aging interventions objectively.

punchline.text: 353 methylation sites. Your body's true age revealed.

quiz.question: What does the Horvath epigenetic clock measure?
options: Biological age via DNA methylation patterns
